lines.english: "See you then, Haruki-kun."
"I'm so sorry, Setsuna… I really don't know what to say…"
"Oh jeez, stop it. You should be in bed, not seeing me off."
"…! I'm sorry."
Due to my headache and my awful chill, it hurts just to talk.
But this isn't the time to feel sorry for myself. It's nothing compared to how I've treated Setsuna…
"You were so busy this week that you could barely get any sleep, right? Then at least use the weekend to get some rest."
"I know, but… how many times can I keep breaking my promises…?"
It's Friday, the day after I stood Setsuna up on her own birthday.
Because we couldn't abide by our one week rule yesterday, we decided to meet up in my apartment as promised.
I was supposed to spend the day alone with Setsuna, and then tomorrow evening we'd go together to her place and celebrate her birthday.
Yet…
"You can't do anything with me in that state anyway. Once you feel better, I'll let you make up for it."
"Setsuna…"
Before the day is even over, Setsuna is planning to leave.
She also canceled our plans to go to the Ogiso household tomorrow.
Even though our anniversary is this week, we spent only two hours together in total.
It's all my fault…
"Come on, don't look so disheartened. You'll only feel worse if you worry too much, you know?"
"S-Sorry…"
"Come on, enough with saying sorry! Pull yourself together and get better… Well, maybe that was too harsh to say to someone who's sick, I'm sorry."
"I'm not sick…"
It's not strange at all that Setsuna would take this for an illness.
I couldn't even eat the dinner she went out of her way to make for me.
I didn't register half of what she was telling me, so I had to keep asking her to repeat herself.
My face is undeniably pale. Everything from the sweat from my forehead to the chill shows no sign of stopping.
And…
"It's always been a bad habit of yours to overestimate yourself. Use all this time to get some sleep, and no working on the weekend, okay?"
"Setsuna."
"Well then, good night. Oh, and thanks for the birthday gift."
"Happy birthday…"
"Thanks… Mh!"
"Mh…"
"See you."
Lastly, she kisses me on the lips and heads the other way through the hallway.
She tried taking care of me when I started feeling sick all of a sudden, as if it was something completely natural…
But right now, I'm neither strong-willed enough nor shameless enough to accept Setsuna's kindness.
What's happening to me? How can I allow this to happen…?
I've been strange since yesterday… or even before that.
Whenever I think of Setsuna…
Whenever I think of her, whenever I worry about her, whenever I feel guilty about her, whenever I think of the secret I keep from her.
Whenever I tell her I love her, whenever I embrace her, whenever I betray her…
My mind and body grow restless. My body and my brain stop working together, and it all stops… working.
"Connecting to voicemail. Please leave your message after the beep."
"No number this time… Setsuna just left. You can come back now."
"I'll be sleeping in my room. If you need anything, just call me. Good night then…"
It's not like I'm using my poor health as an excuse, but I've betrayed Setsuna for the second day in a row.
I deviate further away from the me that Setsuna desires, and turn more into the me that Kazusa desires…
"…Haha."
Though I suppose I can't call myself the me that Kazusa desires when I chased her out of her apartment just so I could have Setsuna stay over.
It's all so selfish of me that I can't help but laugh at it.
Besides, I'm not even sure that I can accept Kazusa the way I am now.
If I go to where she is with the way I am now, there's no telling if things will end up just like it did with Setsuna earlier…
Before I can put my hands on the door handle, I hear the sound of a door opening.
In fact, it wasn't the door of my own apartment that opened…
"…Welcome back, Haruki."
"…Kazusa?"
The door that opened was the door next to mine… the door of the apartment that was supposed to be empty right now.
"I just heard your voicemail… could it be that it's my fault?"
"…What are you saying? There's something much more important here. Why are you…?"
"Hm…?
"Why are you here…? I, I told you… about today, didn't I…?"
"Oh, you mean number 4. I got your message."
"Then… then why? Why won't you listen to what I say…?"
Why couldn't you follow my instructions… of leaving for the night given that I'm having another woman over?
I know what I'm saying is utterly arrogant, despicable and inconsiderate no matter how I look at it. I know full well it's a horrible order…
Even so, I never could have expected Kazusa to disobey it. It's not very commendable, but I simply can't accept this.
Because if Kazusa really was in the apartment next to mine, it means that I've done something far worse than giving her that order.
"Don't tell me, you… last week too?"
"…I'm sorry, I've never listened to that order. Spending the night somewhere else was too much of a pain."
Last week, and the week before that…
The day I fulfilled the one week rule with Setsuna… Kazusa was in the apartment next to ours all along.
"Are you… joking?"
"I'm sorry, Haruki."
To think that she could clearly hear Setsuna's voice… That she could hear Setsuna's voice when she was with me back then.
To think that the one person who shouldn't have heard that of all people actually did end up doing so…
"Why didn't you continue keeping it a secret? Why would you tell me this now…?"
In response to learning the truth of how my despicable order got ignored, I responded by snapping at her and further berating her in an equally despicable manner.
"Because I wanted to see you right away. I didn't want to let this chance go."
"Kazusa…!"
But Kazusa's answer was no less horrible either.
"Because I'm an awful person who pretends to be worried about you and Setsuna, yet was happy to see her leave just now."
She presses the issue without showing any sign of guilt, and brazenly takes everything upon herself with her teeth clenched.
"Because I'm a pervert who felt turned on when you chose me and not Setsuna today…"
She's doing all this for my sake. She's doing this so I can be spared from even more guilt.
Kazusa boldly smiles at me as if to create the illusion that I'm just a victim being played around with by a horrible woman.
"Hey, Haruki… come with me to my room. Or do you want me to come to yours?"
All while her lips shiver, and never looking me straight in the eyes.
"Hey, why don't we go make love? Why don't you let it out on me instead of Setsuna?"
"Kazusa, listen to me. The truth is, I…"
"If you have such a hard time deciding, how about changing the way you think about it?"
"The way I… think about it?"
"Come and… punish me."
"Discipline your unruly dog who refuses to listen to any of her owner's orders."
"Are you…"
"No, wait… it should be 'please discipline me.'"
"You…!"
This can't be happening…
"Hey… hey, Haruki…"
"Kazusa…"
Every time Kazusa takes on the role of the bad guy and seduces me…
Every time she calls out to me in that enticingly seductive way…
Every time she looks up at me with a gaze full of passion…
"Please, punish… me."
"…! Ah… ah… Haruki!"
I… become aroused.
Unable to control myself, I embrace Kazusa with all my strength.
"Y-You… You idiot."
"Yes, so please, please… tell me… with your thing… directly…"
Kazusa moves her hands over my pants. Even I know that I've grown down there.
That's why my parched throat starts to dry up in a mix of complete arousal and a simultaneously welling feeling of despair.
"Kazusa… Kazusa…"
"Ah, ah… Haruki. More, more, more… hold me more tightly… aah…!"
Because…
Even though I couldn't even react that way while I was with Setsuna earlier…
Even though I couldn't bring myself to be a "man" in front of Setsuna…
"…What's the matter?"
"Your thing… moved inside of me again."
"Sorry for being so unruly."
"You're unruly, yet you shut yourself in there all day… You never once try to get out from inside of me…"
"…I'm just kidding. I'm actually happy. So you can stay in there for as long as you want."
"Kazusa…"
What is happening to me…?
Before I realized it, my headache, nausea and chills were all gone.
The only thing that's still present is my sweating, but that goes for Kazusa too…
We entwine around each other soaked in so much sweat that the sheets get wet.
"You didn't… do it with Setsuna, did you? So you felt frustrated, right?"
I came inside Kazusa countless times. Even so, no matter how many times I did it, it just wasn't enough.
"You were holding back because of me, weren't you? So you can let it all out… inside of me."
"Nhm, mh… it's hard again."
That's why I'm lying still now, embracing her without pulling out… but even though I'm not moving at all, it still gets hard every now and then.
Right now, I'm a man who could be considered a brute. I'm a completely different man from who I was only a few hours ago.
Is it because I'm with Kazusa? Is it because I'm thinking only of Kazusa…?
"Though… I don't really mind either way. Whether you make love to Setsuna, or you make love to me."
"…I know."
It's not that I "didn't do it" with Setsuna. More accurately, I couldn't do it.
As usual, Setsuna made dinner and we ate together.
It was a meet-up that was more exciting than usual; I gave her her birthday present and she gave me my Valentine's chocolate.
"As long as you pick me every now and then, I'll think of myself as lucky for that day."
"I said I know…"
I kissed her, took off her clothes and let her take off my clothes. I caressed her and she caressed me…
But we couldn't go any further than that.
"So, so… you don't have to be so hard on yourself."
"Kazusa…"
"Because I never really… hated that you and Setsuna were together."
"That's enough."
"I always loved Setsuna too, and even when you two got… engaged…"
"That's enough, already."
"Of course I was surprised at first, you know… I did think it was a bit sudden… but, but I really did want to give you my blessing…"
"Kazusa…!"
"…Ah, aah… H-Haruki… don't move all of a sudden… Aah, mh!"
"…Sorry."
Almost as if she has completely forgotten about yesterday, Kazusa lies again.
At the first sight of me suffering, she immediately tries to reassure me with something she clearly doesn't believe in.
Which leads to her rebounding, which only brings us greater pain…
"How about taking a rest? I'll still be here when you wake up."
"…When you're still inside me? When I'm feeling this good?"
"…Should I take it out?"
"I understand, I won't say anything unnecessary. I won't say a word. I'll be completely silent. So please… let us stay like this."
"You're really…"
"I don't know about guys… but women… or maybe just I, find this so good. I don't want to ever let it end."
"T-That's not what I meant… I think it feels good too. I was just about to say that you can't just be completely silent."
"Then… should I talk about something?"
"If you can, because I don't think I can fall asleep either like this."
"Then Haruki… ask me something. Just like in our interviews."
"Alright…"
That's why I desire from her a voice that speaks neither lie nor silence, neither poison nor antidote.
Until morning comes, until we're both exhausted, until this wave leaves us.
So we can forget about our guilt… So we can forget completely about who we're feeling guilty for.
"That old man… he didn't want me to return to Japan."
"He didn't?"
"He didn't like me leaving Vienna for two months. He was seriously worried I'd skip practice and get tangled up with some guy."
Kazusa's recollections were neither poison nor antidote, yet they were still too much to include in an article.
Martin Fluegel. Touma Youko's tutor, and a name that always comes up during the topic of modern classical music.
"After all, there's already a precedent for it. His favorite gifted student once got tangled up with a guy and skipped all her practice…"
…I find myself calming down at the prospect that even a grand and historical man such as him is "nothing but an annoying old man" to his foul-mouthed favorite students.
"But… she was still able to become incredibly successful."
Although considering that both mother and daughter describe him in the exact same way, they might actually be speaking the truth.
"If you ask him, the reason Youko couldn't manage to win the Giovanni International Competition was because of her promiscuous lifestyle back then… and just a year later, I was born."
"Even then, I never expected him to look at me the same way… I've never skipped a single lesson of his."
"Yes…"
"I even practice ten hours every day out of my own free will. I never miss a single session… mostly."
"You're amazing… Kazusa."
I think she said this during the interview too, that it was all "my fault"…
"But when I did come to Japan, I got tangled up with a guy and utterly failed my first concert."
"Moreover, I have another concert coming up in two weeks, and I haven't practiced for it at all."
"Nothing you could do about that… you were wounded."
"My wound also had to do with a guy, though. And even if the wound heals, I'll still be tangled up with you."
I could tell she was going to deride herself.
But because I wanted to talk about something that was neither poison nor antidote, it wasn't a topic I wanted her to touch.
"It's strange… how could he possibly have known? That I would end up failing because of a man, that I would end up like my mother."
"Kazusa…"
"I never talked about guys in front of him. I never told him a thing about you."
"That's…"
That's probably where the rumors come from…
"Even though I'm different from my mom. Even though I never bothered with any men for five whole years… Even though you're the only one I've got."
"Kazusa…"
"Even though I have no interest in other men, and will never have any interest in them for the rest of my life."
"Don't… say that."
"Why not?"
"Because…"
It's too much to handle.
I know I can't accept Kazusa for her whole life with the way I am now…
"Didn't I tell you before? There's only one person I see as a man in the whole world."
"I started thinking that… there's probably only one man in the world who keeps getting close to me no matter how many times I push him away."
"Your world is far too narrow…"
Just because you're in the middle of making love to me, doesn't mean I want you to say such extreme things.
Do you know you'll only make me worried about what will happen to you from now on if you say stuff like that?
"My world, you think it's narrow?"
"You know… how old do you think you are…?"
If everything goes as you planned, we'll break up in two weeks.
"Do you think I'm being too clingy? Are you going to tell me something worthless like, 'You'll find a better guy than me one day?'…?"
"Like I keep saying… don't call that worthless."
Yet you're still acting like an infant… Will you ever find happiness if you leave me?
"But it is worthless… All men aside from you are all worthless to me."
"But I'm the most worthless man among them, aren't I?"
"Of course not."
You're going to cause so many problems if you're going to be so obsessed with me.
"I don't even suit you. I keep doing these awful things… hurting both you and Setsuna."
If you act so passionately with me, I won't be able to take my eyes off you.
I'll become incapable of letting go of you…
"I'm just one of many guys who happened to be near you five years ago… nothing more than that."
"What's 'nothing more' supposed to mean?"
"…Kazusa?"
No matter how much I try to shake you off.
The strength in Kazusa's arms as she holds me now, is the same strength she used to grab on to my sleeve five years ago.
"Five years ago, my world was just as broad as yours or Setsuna's. There were hundreds of guys around me."
"Does that mean…"
Because I was just a student who went to the same school as them. There was nothing special about me.
…Kazusa was the only one who was a little bit special.
"But there was only a single one… who earnestly chose me… who earnestly looked at me."
There were those who were jealous of her because of that, and those who hated her because of that.
It was because she was special that she tried to avert her gaze from it.
"Setsuna… picked you out of all the hundreds of guys she could have picked."
"But I… had no one else to pick but you from the very start."
But I alone didn't understand why Kazusa was special.
"So if you tell me that the world is broader after all this time… that there are many other guys for me to find, I won't believe it."
That's why I wrongly assumed it was her looks that made her special. I kept piling on that misunderstanding, and approached her.
"I'd rather continue to have feelings for that single guy, who out of hundreds… saw the part of me that was still normal."
But that misinformed approach was something she never expected, and it hit her weak spot.
"It's much more enjoyable to just… think about you."
And the wounds she suffered from five years ago still torment her.
Every time winter arrives, she is reminded of that pain, and those feelings.
"Why is that a bad thing? Isn't it like destiny?"
"Is it really that enjoyable…? You only keep getting treated awfully by me. You only keep suffering because of me."
"But you still make love to me like you do now. My feelings are reaching you."
"Kazusa… Kazusa!"
"We don't have to go all the way. We can just remain like this… I'll be as happy as I can until it's over."
"What about my wish… that you'll be happy for the rest of your life?"
"It has already come true… isn't that nice, Haruki?"
"How could it…"
I could easily call that a lie.
But to get Kazusa to admit that it's a lie, is not something I'm capable of anymore…
"…Let's go to sleep. You seem to have calmed down yourself."
"Ah…"
In the end, the words Kazusa spoke, which were supposed to be neither poison nor antidote, didn't feel all that warm.
So as I lie down while being held by Kazusa, I lose my strength, and invite Kazusa with me to oblivion.
"Is it okay if I stay like this…? I'm not heavy, am I?"
"I want it to be heavy. I want to be able to feel you, Kazusa."
"…Thank you. Then feel me with your whole body."
"Yeah… You too, Kazusa."
"Good night."
"Good night…"
Along with those words, Kazusa relaxes her whole body on top of me, and as expected, I'm enveloped by a pleasant weight.
It's almost as if her body will never let go of me again. That soft, warm, captivating and sweet-smelling body.
She touches my cheeks, strokes my back, pushes against my chest, touches my abdomen with her own, rubs my lower body, entwines her legs with mine, and breathes in my ear.
All while we're still connected…
"If you could listen to one more favor from me…"
"Eh?"
"If you could send me not a flower, but a new sprout… then I'd be even happier."
"Are you…"
"Kazusa…?"
"…Mh… nh."
She could have been pretending to be asleep.
It could have been a way to keep the meaning behind her words ambiguous.
"Good night."
But as I am right now…
No, as I had done before, I swore to never look into the meaning behind those words.
"Haruki…"
"Hey, Haruki…"
"Mh… nhm…"
"Are you sure you should still be sleeping? You know today is…"
"Fuuu… haah…"
"Mh… mh…"
"Nhm, mh… ah."
"Nh, nhmmm… mh."
"Mhm… aah… ahmh…"
"Mph… Mhaah… ah…"
"Nhm, mmh, ah… aah… Haruki… ahm, mhh, ah!"
"Hah, aah, aah… Kazusa…! Haahm… nhm…!"
"Mhmm… nhm… Nhhhhh! Haaaaah… Haah… haah…"
"Aaaah… haaah… aaah, Kazusa…!"
"Ah, aah… ah… haah, ah… Good morning, Haruki."
"Don't you 'good morning' me… what are you…"
The kiss was far too intense for a good morning kiss. The sides of both our mouths are completely covered in saliva.
"Ah, well… you wouldn't wake up when I called your name, so…"
"You put your tongue in people's mouths just because they won't wake up?"
It felt far too good.
"No, but you know, um…"
"Haaaah, well, it doesn't matter. So what time is it?"
"That's what I was about to tell you… it's 8:30."
"I see… It seems like I overslept quite a bit, even though it's Sunday. I'm sorry."
"Haruki…"
It might be my day off, but it's still completely unheard of for me to sleep longer than Kazusa.
Perhaps it has something to do with my health recently…
"It's Monday… though."
"Your alarm clock went off at 6 o'clock, which woke me up… then I went back to sleep and woke up again just now…"
"…Monday?"
"You said last night that you had to go to work today and that you needed to take care of something in the morning, so we should sleep in your apartment."
"M-My shirt! My socks! Huh? Where are my clean clothes?"
Something like this is simply unheard of.
"Hey, you don't have to be in such a rush. It's not that big of a deal for a journalist to be late. Most of your work is done at night, anyway."
"I'll correct your distorted understanding of my job some other time. I have a meeting with Hamada-san first thing in the morning today."
Not because I slept longer than Kazusa, but because I overslept so much that I'm late for work.
Usually I always wake up at 6:30 every morning…
"Ah, by the way, since you look so busy, I'll make breakfast. You should grab a…"
"I'll pass on that for more reasons than one! Alright, I'm off!"
"And yet you get mad at me for skipping breakfast…"
"How are you feeling?"
"You'll have to go back to work from today, will you be okay?"
"Did you measure your temperature? What did it say? Did you go to the doctor?"
"Haruki-kun, I'm worried because you always keep everything bottled up during times like this… In any case, please don't overdo it, okay?"
"Your attention please. The train on Line 1 heading toward Onjuku will arrive shortly. Please stand behind the yellow line."
Somehow, I managed to make it in time… If I get on this train, I'll be able to get to work by 10 o'clock.
"I'm sorry about last week."
"I'm sorry for always causing you to worry. I'm commuting to work right now."
Once I'm there, I'll go straight to the conference room and report my progress.
"I feel better now. My temperature has gone down significantly since yesterday. I'm pretty much back to normal today."
Then I'll get back to my seat and get to work.
…I left early on Thursday and barely even made any progress on Friday, so I'm a little afraid of looking at my inbox.
"More importantly, I'm really sorry about last week. I'll make it up to you next time. Let your family know that as well."
In the afternoon, I'll have to go straight to Ensemble's editing department for a meeting… The topic is our approach on compiling the special number on Touma Kazusa.
This current job might be one done along with professionals, but it's also my first job as a direct participant, which ought to be commemorated.
"The train just arrived. I'll contact you again."
Although that might just be because of my connections to Touma Youko Office and their strong desire to have me on, I still can't let this chance go.
The deadline is at the end of February, and it'll go on sale at the beginning of March. All while the Touma Kazusa craze hasn't died down yet.
Everything is going at a rapid pace already from the beginning of the week. There's no point in even thinking about taking sick leave.
Will everything be fine…?
It's my first editing job with this much responsibility. And it's not even for Kaiou Graph with which I'm so familiar with, but for Ensemble.
The amount of support Hamada-san can give me is limited, and I can't rely on the usual gang for help. I bet that things are going to get quite hectic from this week on.
Will everything be alright…?
Will Setsuna be alright? Will her family be alright? What about our future? What about our promise?
And then…
"Haah…"
What am I saying? There's no point thinking about all that. For now, I'll have to start with the things I'm able to take care of.
First, I'll go to the office, then I'll start working. I'll go back to how my daily life used to be.
My true daily life…
"…Alright."
I put some force into my knees to stand up from the bench, and head for the train…
"The doors for Line 1 are closing. Please be careful."
"Hmm…"
"It always looks so easy when he does it."
"Actually, it probably is easy."
"More importantly…"
"How do I… turn off this alarm?"
"…Maybe Haruki was right, and I shouldn't be cooking after all."
"You're completely right."
From the burnt smell coming from inside the apartment, I could feel the same sense of foreboding I had just a few days ago.
"What's the matter, Haruki…? Didn't you go to…"
"We'll talk about that later! Open the window now!"
…Not that I wanted to be right, though.
"Look, it's done. This time it's light brown."
"Ah, okay…"
You could say she lacks the skills to make fried eggs, but it takes a special kind of carelessness to burn regular toast coal black…
Seriously, she's known for her skills all over the world, yet the utter contrast between what she's good at and what she's bad at is straight out of a manga story.
"So, back to what I said… Why did you come back, Haruki? …Don't tell me you saw the smoke all the way from the station?"
"I forgot something."
"Forgot what?"
"…My recorder."
"Why would you come all the way back for that? Surely you don't need it…"
"…The things you talked about last week, about your teacher. I had it stored on the recorder."
"But you weren't recording back then, right?"
"…I quietly recorded everything I remembered by myself after that, once you were already asleep."
"…Really?"
"Why would I lie about this?"
"I can't think of anything, but…"
"I see… It's alright, then."
I can feel Kazusa staring at me from behind.
Probably because even I would find my answer unnatural…
"Here, your fried eggs. Out with your plate."
"Ah, okay."
But I ignore her doubtful look, and instead put the eggs I just finished frying on her plate. Once that's done, I look through the fridge for vegetables.
"So… did you find what you were looking for?"
"Yes, kind of…"
"So… are you going back to work when you're done eating?"
"Isn't it… about time for you to start practicing too?"
"Ah, yes. That's right."
"I see…"
"Right…"
Because I was so worked up about the possibility of being late for work when I left my residence, this strange atmosphere wasn't present earlier.
This indescribable sense of loneliness, this strange feeling where we reach out our arms and lightly clutch the hem of each other's shirts, though only in our hearts.
"Y-You know…"
"Hm?"
This feeling of waiting for one of us to break the silence, wondering how we're going to settle things, swaying from side to side as we look for the right words to say…
"The truth is… my superior gave me permission to come back. Once I called and reported to him, he told me I didn't need to come in for today."
"…You don't?"
And in the end, the path we ended up on was a comfortable one.
To me right now, it's the most pleasant path; a peaceful one without any storms.
"He's out for an interview during the afternoon, and since I can't attend any meetings today anyway…"
"O-Ooh…"
"And it's almost like I'm on a business trip in the first place… handling Touma Kazusa and all."
"T-Then… does that mean that doing this is your work?"
"Obviously I can't get away with just this… I'm doing my regular job at home today… You know, working on the interview I held with you last week."
"Haruki…"
"So uh, I'll be at home today. Nowadays, you can work from anywhere as long as you have access to your email."
"I, I see…"
"Right…"
"Haruki… you're going to be at home all day?"
"I guess so."
And I'm sure right now, Kazusa too, likely finds this path to be…
"H-Hey…"
"Hm?"
"Since you're at it, why not do your job at my place? I won't get in the way."
"Forget about getting in the way. Don't you have practice?"
"I'll just look at you. If it gets distracting, I'll move to the corner, so you can focus on your job."
"…It's fine as long as you don't distract me, just don't go pouring coffee for me out of consideration. There's no undoing it if you spill it all on my PC."
And there's no one to upset this atmosphere. This path is both pleasant and peaceful for Kazusa.
Because this is the path that lets the two of us be all alone together.
"I got it already! Why would I even bother doing housework when you're around? I'll leave all of that to you."
"You…"
And just like that, I affirm Kazusa's attempt to run away.
After all, I of all people have no right to criticize her for that.
Not when I ran straight back home within minutes of being outside, just so I could escape and return to the world made only for the two of us.
"Aren't you going to listen to the recorder?"
"It's all stored in my mind."
I'm amazed at myself for how poor that excuse was…
"I see… That's just like you, Haruki."
But Kazusa simply admires me for those words, and with a bump, she puts her head on my left shoulder.
It's likely that it's not that she isn't doubting my words; rather, she's given up on thinking about things altogether.
"Hey… is it okay if I write about this? Fluegel's evaluation of Touma Youko."
"You mean about how I was born as a result of her time of promiscuity? I don't mind."
"…No, not that. I meant how he thought she had the ability to win the contest without trying."
"You don't need my permission to write about something that boring…"
"Also, what about the part where unlike your mother, you haven't skipped a single lesson?"
"If you write that, it'll look like I'm trying to make up for my lack of natural skill."
"It's the truth, so what of it? …No matter how you look at it, you're much more of a hard-worker than Youko-san."
"She's more of a genius than me…"
"I really like how you're kind of an upstart in that way, though."
"Hmph."
Kazusa starts sulking a bit and bumps her jaw against my shoulder a few times.
"Well, of course you have talent. It's not even comparable to the average person, and maybe even compared to other pianists…"
"Like I care."
"But I think the reason you finish in similar positions to her is because you put in more effort…"
"In that case, how would you explain the fact that I skipped practice for three whole years back in high school?"
Bump, bump, bump… her head rises up and down on my shoulder again and again.
"What's up with you? Would you rather be seen as a genius instead?"
"Didn't I already tell you? I don't care what anyone thinks of me other than you."
"…Yeah, yeah."
"Don't just let that slide…"
…She's completely letting herself loose around me.
"So what do you think about my evaluation that Touma Kazusa is an upstart? You care about what I think, right?"
"I'm half annoyed, half angry… and half happy."
"That totals to 150%, you know…"
"But you're an even bigger upstart than I am, Haruki. Yet you're treating me like I'm the inferior one and protecting me even though it's beyond your means…"
"Kazusa…"
"Mh… nh."
As I turn to her, she lightly pushes her lips against mine, and then immediately bumps her head back on my shoulder.
But this time, she doesn't keep hitting me; instead, she rubs her hair against me.
"I'm happy."
"I see…"
The second half of that comment is not something I could put in an interview article, though.
Though perhaps… I can keep it in my memory as a third-rate article forever.
"Hey, Haruki."
"What is it this time?"
"Am I being annoying?"
"Not at all."
"I thought so. This much is fine, right?"
The woman who kept verbally abusing me five years ago is letting out an expression befitting of a girl's at my immediate reassurance.
"…There's only two weeks left. You can handle this much for that long, right, Haruki?"
"I've never felt that way in the first place. I don't even feel like I'm forced to bear anything right now."
Ever since I crossed the final line with Kazusa, the feeling of her skin and the warmth of her body has never caused me pain again.
"In fact, I find it more annoying that you keep repeating 'two weeks, two weeks' all the time."
"Huh…?"
On the contrary, whenever Kazusa gently pushes her skin against mine, whenever she touches my lips, and whenever she accepts me, I feel peace return to my heart.
I feel a kind of euphoria that by far supersedes any feelings of guilt over my betrayal, and I find myself wanting to experience it over and over again.
"I don't remember making a promise like that… it's something you went and decided on your own."
"Haruki…"
"We still… haven't decided anything."
However, that euphoria might be the same kind that one gets when taking highly addictive drugs.
"So, that's why… Kazusa."
"Ah…"
That's why, as if I'm swept away by some fever, I strongly pull Kazusa into my arms and push her down on the bed.
"I want to feel you more and more."
"H-Haruki…?"
"I want to feel your warmth. I want to feel your softness. I want to smell your scent."
"Ah, aah…"
"…You're okay with it, right?"
"B-But… it's still 10 o'clock in the morning, you know?"
"…So what?"
"…If we start now, we'll have so much time to make love."
"Yeah… we still have fourteen more hours left of the day."
"That sounds… like something out of a dream."
I'm doing this so I can calm down my heart. So I can continue being myself…
"Hah, ah, ah… ah, aah… Haruki…"
I'm doing this so I can free myself from the severe withdrawal from the drug called Kazusa…
I need to do this so I can rid my body from the dizzying headache and throbbing of my heart that attacked me even this morning when I boarded the train.
